## OP-20 disclosures

1. **Account-size assumption:** The validation uses the same account-size assumption as the base engine: qty=28 requires $25K+; $1K paper ~= 14% headline.
2. **Sample bias:** The sample is the three winner J days. Selection method: these are the three days with the highest positive P&L in the J set. Overfit risk: low because we are not optimizing on these days, we are validating a pre-existing candidate.
3. **Out-of-sample:** The candidate has already undergone OOS validation (see leaderboard: guard 29/29 PASS). We do not redo OOS for this analysis.
4. **Real-fills:** The candidate has undergone real-fills validation (see leaderboard: real-fills A/B). We do not redo real-fills for this analysis.
5. **Failure modes:** The quality gate may fail to fire on a day where it should (missing a veto opportunity) or fire on a day where it should not (blocking a winner). On the J days, we observed no failures (no fires on winner days, and we did not check loser days for this analysis).
6. **Concentration:** The three winner days account for 100% of the J days winner P&L. The candidate does not change the P&L on these days, so concentration remains 100%.
